A02 order test, rules written before it runs (G33): the census of my D3a-28 rulings by room, out/_analysis/d3_a02_census.py. Each line takes the class it was ruled under: instantiate O, J+, J, BOUND, ONE, OTHER (A02-inst-spec.txt); restrict S-O, S-J+, S-BOUND, EL, C, P-LOCAL, P-G6 (A02-restrict-spec.txt); adds a joint opening, or J+ where the reason names a later rally or call; absent rejects the order, or J+ where the reason names a joint opening followed by a later call; absent accepts evidence limits. Every class is checked against the decision and kind in the written files. A room counts in each class its lines show, and once by priority (order, J+, bound, falsifier, joint, one end, other, limit). Holds are rooms with the order or J+; an episode is a hold, the bound's pattern or the falsifier; rooms in both a hold and the bound are named; rooms with only joint openings are counted apart, as G33's amendment says. The count is reported beside C2's (64 of 89, 0.719). Reading rule: the counts inform the status ruling and its bound; no line ruling changes because of a count
